title: GPAT-TransferBench v1.0 -- M7D1-A1 adversarial curriculum amendment
naming_note: Identifier M7D1-A1 is used because docs/spec/amendments already holds an unrelated v1.0 Amendment A1 (Fair ID-Free Main Track); M7D1-A1 is NOT that amendment and is NOT part of the original frozen specification.

N3.finding: lambda_adv jump 0 -> 0.05 at u5526 caused the seed42 closed-mask identity collapse (u5781)

N4.finding: R1 (1-epoch ramp to u6630) and R2 repaired the known mechanism to u16575; R1 preferred as the smaller deviation

N5.finding: original stage-3 transition S0 (0.05 -> 0.10 jump at u16576) qualified to u27625; no second ramp required

A_n5_anchor_acceptance.scope: N5 diagnostic provenance only; never a resume point for a scientific run
A_n5_anchor_acceptance.replay: bitwise equal to N4 R1 u16575, no AMP event

owner_decisions_recorded_in_N6A.B_curriculum_amendment: approved for a fresh scientific run starting at u1

amended_schedule.summary: one-epoch linear ramp u5526..u6630 (1105 updates); stage-3 jump 0.05 -> 0.10 at u16576 unchanged

float_definition.non_canonical_warning: (0.05 * (u - 5526)) / 1104 is algebraically equal but differs in the last bit at 378 of the 1105 ramp updates; it is NOT the definition

unchanged: main LR (G_OPT, D_OPT) and attack-warmup LR
all loss terms and fixed weights
frozen method configs gpat_b0..b3.yaml and their sha256 (their descriptive curriculum tables stay v1.0 text; runtime uses runtime_contract)

applies_to.mechanism: every method calls runtime_contract.curriculum(u) in Trainer.attempt; no method-specific lambda_adv path

run_identity.provenance_key: curriculum_id (run manifest, recovery + EMA candidate metadata; resume refuses mismatch)

planned_N6B_run.start: fresh from u1 (no snapshot, no N4/N5 anchor)
planned_N6B_run.launch_commit: the M7D1-A1 adoption commit (or an owner-approved descendant); run_id is fixed at launch

checkpoint_policy_N6B.train: full 60 epochs (66300 updates) unless a true hard failure occurs
checkpoint_policy_N6B.selection: per seed, VAL only, frozen spec 10.6 percentile-rank SelectionScore (0.25 ID + 0.15 Dice + 0.25 ArtSim + 0.20 -NME + 0.15 -LFErr; tie: ArtSim, then earlier epoch)
checkpoint_policy_N6B.use: best selected EMA checkpoint, NOT the final epoch by default

limitations: stage-3 qualification only reached u27625 of 66300
gadv share of G gradient rises
G gradient clipping is frequent (~100% in N5 stage 3)
historical_tools_note: N3/N4 diagnostic tools take rc.curriculum as their frozen base; re-running them against the v1.0 trajectory requires their authority commits (under A1 their base would no longer be the v1.0 trajectory). N5 starts at u16576, where A1 == v1.0.
